references.text: The same principle regarding unintentional sin against holy things, requiring restitution plus a fifth and a guilt offering to the Lord.
The addition of a fifth as restitution for holy things that have been desecrated by error.
The rule about adding a fifth when redeeming something dedicated to the Lord.
A fifth must be added to the value when something holy is redeemed.
When redeeming tithes, a fifth must be added to the value.
Restitution with an addition of a fifth for guilt against another person, given to the priest if there is no kinsman-redeemer.
Regulations concerning sins committed by error (bishgagah), using the same Hebrew expression.
Laws regarding unintentional sins and how they are to be atoned for.
